checks: Selected folder is remembered and restored.
Folder permission checks use the granted tree URI.
Consecutive autosaves update the revision token.
Native stale-revision errors propagate without hiding an external update.
Missing-file errors retain their DOMException name.
Detached Blob export survives immediate URL revocation.
Exports request a fresh target instead of overwriting an existing export.
MMB save locks editing, repeat Save, and Back until completion.
Back reports unsaved MMB or companion edits.
Pause flushes the existing companion queue without saving the MMB.
Report HTML is handed to native printing.
Read, commit, failure, and abort leave no pending transfer tokens.
limitations: Node contract tests with a mock native provider.
Android SAF recovery, printing, UI layout, and physical-device behavior require device testing.
